topics.topic: Aadhaar – World’s Largest Biometric Identity System
topics.why_in_news: PIB highlighted Aadhaar’s scale, governance role and privacy safeguards amid discussions on digital identity, welfare delivery and data protection.
prelims_quick_notes: Aadhaar is unique biometric identity system of India.
Implemented by Unique Identification Authority of India (UIDAI).
Provides identity authentication using biometric and demographic data.
Supports Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) and JAM Trinity.
Enables portability of welfare benefits across India.
Authentication modes include OTP, biometric and demographic verification.
Supports digital governance and financial inclusion.
Focus on balancing inclusion, efficiency and privacy.
important_facts: UIDAI functions under Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY).
Aadhaar became statutory after Aadhaar Act 2016.
Supreme Court upheld Aadhaar with restrictions in Puttaswamy judgement (2018).
JAM Trinity = Jan Dhan + Aadhaar + Mobile.
India has one of the world’s largest biometric identity databases.
exam_relevance: Important for Governance, Indian Society and Digital Inclusion.
Useful for DBT, privacy, welfare delivery and digital governance topics.
Can be linked with Article 21, data protection and social inclusion.
prelims_traps: UIDAI functions under MeitY, not Ministry of Home Affairs.
Aadhaar authentication includes biometric and non-biometric methods.
Supreme Court allowed Aadhaar with proportional restrictions, not unlimited mandatory usage.
